name: Account Request Rejection V 04
definition: The AccountRequestRejection message is sent from a financial institution to an organisation. This message is sent in response to a request message from the organisation, if the business content is not valid.

References.name: References
References.definition: Set of elements for the identification of the message and related references.

From.name: From
From.definition: Identifies the business sender of the message, if it is not the account owner or account servicing financial institution.

AccountServicerIdentification.name: Account Servicer Identification
AccountServicerIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a financial institution, as assigned under an internationally recognised or proprietary identification scheme.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

DigitalSignature.name: Digital Signature
DigitalSignature.definition: Contains the signature with its components, namely signed info, signature value, key info and the object.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
